classifications.subject: [AINews] Death of Params: Z.ai CEO Jie Tang on GLM 5.3 and the new Post-training Scaling Law
classifications.reason: Z.ai CEO Jie Tang discusses GLM 5.3 and a new 'Post-training Scaling Law' concept. Core claim: parameter count is no longer the sole measure of model capability — 'Parameter count is only meaningful alongside three others — how much data you have, where you intend to spend your compute, and who will run the model, under what conditions.' Context: open-weight Fable-class model predicted by end of 2026; Qwen 3.8 Max and Kimi K3 are 2-3T models with Fable estimated at 3-7T, only 2 points higher on AA index. This is directly relevant to the existing concepts/glm-5-3.md page (created Aug 14, enriched Aug 16 with Nathan Lambert strategic analysis + Superintel+ post-training economics) and concepts/scaling-laws or related pages. The 'Death of Params' framing (post-training as the new scaling axis) is a new conceptual angle not yet captured.
classifications.action: scrape_article, update concepts/glm-5-3.md with Jie Tang post-training scaling law quote, consider new concept page on post-training scaling laws or update existing scaling-laws concept page
